label: Furnished office room (L3DAS21/22 recordings)
note: approximate size from the L3DAS22 paper ('a real office room'; the L3DAS team is at Sapienza University of Rome, the paper does not name the place); office furniture, wooden parquet floor, painted concrete walls and ceiling; mic A at the centre at 1.3 m, mic B 20 cm away along the width; the IRs are 0.15 s long as published, so no reverberation time (rt_mid) can be measured, and EDT (median 0.43 s), C50 and DRR are the usable values
